subject: Media Literacy
title: Recognizing Your Own Biases
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Recognizing Your Own Biases.

hook.text: You instantly believe negative news about politicians you dislike and dismiss negative news about ones you like.

buildup.text: Self-awareness about your own biases is the foundation of media literacy. Everyone has them.

discovery.text: Notice your emotional reactions to news. Strong immediate reactions usually signal bias activation, not clear thinking.

twist.text: The stories you share fastest and fact-check least are the ones most aligned with your existing biases.

climax.text: You can't eliminate your biases. But you can notice them in action and pause before they control your response.

punchline.text: The bias you don't see is the one that controls you most.

quiz.question: How can you identify your own media biases?
options: Notice which stories you believe instantly and which you immediately dismiss
Ask a friend what your biases are
